key_features: Metal fixing system for the T818 base for use on a desk or table
The support adapts to all solid desks allowing the use of a steering wheel developing a significant force feedback (minimum thickness: 0.6 inches / 1.5 cm; maximum thickness: 1.6 inches / 4.1 cm).
The screws supplied with the support also allow it to be used on a cockpit (not supplied)
review_summary: The Desk Mounting Kit is a stand that allows you to use the T818 by adapting to any type of desk 1 for a stress-free gaming experience. The support is made of metal and allows a solid and robust attachment to take full advantage of the impressive force feedback of the T818. The screws supplied with the support also allow it to be used on a cockpit.2
